LanguageData.LP_HalfElfTalentA_Shooting.label: versatile: shooting (first)
LanguageData.LP_HalfElfTalentA_Shooting.description: A half-elf's first talent: Shooting ability +4 (a bonus like skill levels). Talents in the same group are mutually exclusive; pick one from each of the two groups, and a generated half-elf never gets the same talent twice.
